## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e501d4f1b2faaee32f6fda141046ca7fa95d7a8c`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read, and nothing else: card #20603 body and all five comments (triage `5886114258`, `domain:services` pointer `5890431862`, serial `5894946175`, claim `5910694111`, os-dev-report `5911738863`); PR #20858 body, file list (3 files, +185/-0) and the net diff `688ddef3c..e501d4f1b2` (one commit on the branch); the check-runs on the head collapsed latest-per-name; the #11684 precedent `1f6d04703d`; and the tree at the merge-base `688ddef3c` through `git show` for `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `security-explain-envelope.test.ts`, `security-routes.test.ts`, plugin-security `explain-engine.ts` and `errors.ts`, formula `matches-filter.ts`, spec `errors.zod.ts`, types `thrown-http-error.ts`, ADR-0112 and twelve sibling changesets.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) The arm and its classification — right.**
- The diff is +42 lines inside the `security/explain` handler's `catch` in `rest-server.ts`: after the 404 arm (base `:11728-11730`), before `logError` (base `:11731`) and the `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED` terminal (base `:11735`). It adds no import: `classifiedRefusalAnswer` (base `:385`), `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus` (base `:93`, from `@objectstack/spec/api`) and `ErrorCode` were already in scope.
- `classifiedRefusalAnswer` at `688ddef3c` (`error-response.ts:2513`) is byte-identical to the function `1f6d04703d` added: a declared 5xx answers `undefined`; a declared 4xx (`status` or `statusCode`, via `declaredHttpStatus`) AND a non-empty string `code`, or a sandbox `innerMessage`, goes through `resolveErrorResponse` and is returned only if it resolves below 500. That is the one predicate the `/data` door owns and the analytics door (base `:11385`) and the three record-share catches (base `:11990`) already ask. The new arm carries no code literal and no local predicate — triage's ⛔ holds.
- Ordering: the 403 and 404 arms are unchanged and run first. Right on both counts: the `msg.startsWith('[Security] Access denied')` limb and a bare `code: 'OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'` with no status would not classify, so moving them would drop refusals; and `ExplainObjectNotFoundError` / `PermissionDeniedError` (plugin-security `errors.ts`) declare both status and code, so they WOULD classify — running the hand arms first keeps their `msg.slice(0, 1000)` messages byte-identical.
- What actually reaches the new arm: the matcher's `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 (`matches-filter.ts:163,229,511-526`) propagated as raised, and the engine's `crossFieldRefusalForExplain` (`explain-engine.ts:927-949`), which copies `code` and `status` onto a fresh Error and rides the matcher error as `cause`. `refuseWhatTheMatcherRefuses` (`:998`, called at `:1787`) is on the base, so the object-level and missing-row passes throw that same envelope. The declared-5xx control has a real producer too — `PermissionSetReadUnansweredError` (`DATABASE_ERROR` / 500, `errors.ts:286-289`) — and keeps `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED`.
- No arm of `structuredCodeAnswer` names `INVALID_FILTER`, so it takes the generic passthrough of `resolveErrorResponse`: `{ status: 400, body: { error: safeMsg, ...thrownCodeFields(error, 400) } }`. `INVALID_FILTER` is a `StandardErrorCode` member (`errors.zod.ts:65`), so `resolveThrownHttpError` keeps it verbatim and `demotedDeclaredCode` answers nothing — the wire code is the producer's.
- The `standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus` fallback: right, and it cannot re-stamp a producer's code. It fires only when `refusal.body.code` is not a string. In the declared-envelope limb `thrownCodeFields` always answers a `code` (`declaredCode` is the spelled string, so its early `{}` return is not taken): the producer's own when registered, the status-derived member with the spelling beside it as `declaredCode` when not — both decided by the shared resolver in `@objectstack/types`, never by this arm. Only the sandbox limb (no spelled code) reaches the fallback, where there is no code to re-stamp; the floor (`400` to `VALIDATION_ERROR`) is the one record-share applies (base `:12048-12051`). No explain producer carries `innerMessage`, so that limb is unreachable today — structurally right, currently dormant.
- Logging: a classified refusal now returns before `logError('[REST] Security explain error:')`. Right — a refusal is the caller's answer, and `/data` already lists `INVALID_FILTER` in `isExpectedQueryRejection` (`error-response.ts:2556`) for the same reason. The 500 terminal keeps its `logError` and its own 500-char slice, unchanged.

**(b) Pins — present, both shapes and all controls.**
- `security-explain-envelope.test.ts` section 3 drives five request shapes — record-grained with a row's id; record-grained with an id no row carries; object-level POST; object-level GET; batch `recordIds`, whose object-level call throws first — each asserting `expectNestedEnvelope(answer, 400, 'INVALID_FILTER')` (status, nested `error.code`, string message, both retired dialects absent) AND the exact request the service received (`toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)`, `mock.calls[0][0]` equals the shape). Producer shapes: the engine's `explainRefusal()` (fresh Error, code and status copied, `cause`), the matcher's own, and the `statusCode` spelling. Controls: a plain `Error` still answers `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED`; a code with no status answers 500; 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` and 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` unchanged. Section 2 gains the #8073 skeleton case for the new arm.
- The missing-row shape is driven by request shape against a mocked service; which ids exist is the service's decision and PR #20629 pins that side in plugin-security. The route-level pin is the right level for this card, and the hand-built `explainRefusal()` matches `crossFieldRefusalForExplain` field for field.
- The base pin `security-routes.test.ts:152` (`boom` answers `EXPLAIN_FAILED`) still holds: a plain Error does not classify.

**(c) Message — not a regression; nothing newly leaked.**
- Old arm: `msg.slice(0, 500)`, a hard cut at 500 characters with no marker. New arm: the classification's `error`, i.e. `truncateClientMessage` (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX = 500`, `error-response.ts:72,109-112`): under 500 verbatim, otherwise 499 characters plus one ellipsis. Same wire length, one producer character fewer, and the cut is now visible. The producer's remedy is its last sentence (`crossFieldRefusalForExplain` fixed text is 335 characters with the remedy from index 211, before the subject and diagnostic are added), so the dev's 602-character reading — theirs, not re-measured here — cuts the remedy under both arms; the old arm did the same.
- Nothing leaked: the old arm already forwarded the producer's message on the 500. The new arm forwards the same text plus the producer's `code`, which is the fix. The classification never reads `cause`; `issues`, `declaredCode` and `userMessage` are not re-dressed (only `code` and message are), so the wire gains nothing the old arm withheld. `withoutDeclaredCodePrefix` and the sandbox unwrap are the `/data` door's own rules and do not touch these messages.

**(d) Changeset — accurate.**
- `.changeset/20603-explain-route-classified-refusal.md`: `'@objectstack/rest': patch`; title ends `(#20603)`, the convention on the twelve sibling changesets read at `688ddef3c`; `Clause-②: no` with no arm, the right form for a `no`. The body names the three shapes, the old two-arm catch, the `/data` classification, the bound, and the unchanged set (unclassified, declared 5xx and half envelope stay 500; 403/404; the success body) — each true of the diff. No model identifier; nothing claimed that the diff does not deliver.

Public surface: none of the three paths is a governed surface; head repo equals base repo; 185 changed lines. The auto-generated `content/docs/references/api/*` lists `EXPLAIN_FAILED` as a code only, and it stays live as the unclassified terminal — no doc goes stale.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/rest` `patch`, `Clause-②: no` — right.
- Clause ② is directional about the accept set (`scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs` header: what an author may write, what the runtime accepts). A refusal's response status and code move neither, so `no` with no arm is the correct declaration.
- The published contract is the ADR-0112 nested envelope, which this route already speaks (#8073) and already applies to the refusals it recognises (403, 404). Answering a producer-classified 4xx as `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED` was a defect against that envelope — the card is graded `bug`, and a client that read 500 as an outage was misled. The same-class precedent `1f6d04703d` (#11683 / #11684: hand-built routes moved onto `classifiedRefusalAnswer`, 500 to the producer's 4xx) shipped as `@objectstack/rest` `patch` with an old-to-new note for consumers who branch; this changeset carries the same. The other precedent on this route, `6e4024c764` (#18253, `minor`), is different in kind: it introduced a new refusal where a 200 had been answered and added a producer class in plugin-security. Nothing new is refused here; an existing refusal is reported at its own status. Patch, no arm needed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Deviations (7, all answered):
1. `vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` instead of the literal `test` script — the script at base IS `vitest run --project local` (`packages/rest/package.json:24`); only a worker cap was added. Accepted; `Test Core` green is the gate verdict.
2. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` first exit 3 (no dist), rebuilt, then 0 — accepted; CI ran both fresh (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger` success).
3. Gate batch backgrounded at the tool cap, exit codes read from the results file — accepted; CI is the verdict.
4. Throwaway length script copied into plugin-security, run, removed, never staged — accepted: the file list and the net diff show exactly three files. The 602-character figure remains the dev's reading.
5. `main` not merged — read here: `origin/main` is at `660a9b247e`, six commits past `688ddef3c`, and none touches `rest-server.ts`, `error-response.ts` or the explain test (`git log 688ddef3c..origin/main -- those three paths` is empty). The PR reads `mergeable`; the queue rebuilds on current main, which is §10's second round. Accepted.
6. Model-free trailer pair (`Claude-Session` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude`) instead of the harness's model-named line — that is AGENTS.md's own form. Accepted.
7. No PR labels written; `documentation`, `size/m`, `tests`, `tooling` are labeler-set — accepted. The PR is still draft with auto-merge unarmed; nothing governed is touched, so ready-then-arm is the owning seat's ordinary §7 act once this record stands.

Out-of-scope findings (3, all noted-not-filed by the dev):
(a) Message bound cuts the remedy — ESCALATED for filing; not blocking, no regression. `crossFieldRefusalForExplain` back-loads its remedy (fixed text 335 characters, remedy from index 211, plus subject and diagnostic), and the matcher's own `crossFieldClassError` message is 972 characters with its remedy from index 825 (`matches-filter.ts:512-522` at `688ddef3c`), so the same 500-character bound cuts the remedy in `find`'s answer through `/data` as well as here. A prescription an author is shown that never reaches the wire is a reproducible producer-side defect in `packages/formula` / `plugin-security`, and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #10 says it takes a card. This seat writes nothing to GitHub; the dispatching seat files it.
(b) `declaredCode` / `userMessage` not forwarded — accepted as a note, with the instrument corrected: `declaredCode` is derived by demotion and never spelled by a producer, so grepping producers for the word measures nothing. The right question — does any 4xx producer behind explain spell an unregistered code — answers no today (`INVALID_FILTER`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` are all members), so nothing is dropped; `userMessage` has no producer. The explain family's `respondError` wraps its fifth argument as `{ details }` (base, the closure above the handler) where record-share's passes `sendEnvelopeError`'s `extra` (base `:11858-11864`), so parity is a family-wide emitter change — a follow-on the dispatching seat may card; not a defect today.
(c) Two copies of the nested re-dress (record-share base `:12048-12051` and this arm) — accepted as a note; one shared re-dresser beside `classifiedRefusalAnswer` that also carries `declaredCode` / `userMessage` would close (b) and (c) together. Not blocking.

Checks on `e501d4f1b2` (34 names, latest-per-name, all completed at read time): 31 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` — opt-in or advisory).
